title: RYSK ON HYPERLIQUID
summary_title: Risk: selling covered calls on Hyperliquid to earn premium without options complexity
summary_description: How Risk pivoted from a failed options AMM to a simple income strategy protocol now dominating Hyper-EVM.

key_moments.label: Risk pivoted from options AMM to income-focused strategies after struggling with traction
Core insight: target people seeking income, not traders seeking options complexity
Two user types: those willing to buy/sell at a price, and those betting against price movement
RFQ system: counterparties quote options in 2 seconds, users see best price instantly
Building on Hyper-EVM described as best business decision; launched only there for over a year
Two to four weeks optimal expiry for best risk-reward and price prediction accuracy
Points system launched after users requested leaderboards and activity measurement
Upcoming: automated vaults, bounded options, and more RWA assets on Risk
